subject: English
question_text: Rearrange the sentences to complete the story.
stimulus: (a) He was allowed to play his role. (b) None of them could satisfy the king. (c) They were all taken before the king and they tried their best to tell bigger lies. (d) A king declared a rich prize for the teller of biggest lie. (e) A date was fixed for the competition. (f) Applicants were enlisted serially for competition. (g) When it was nearly to a close of the competition a new comer prayed for a chance to try. (h) He told that the king was a worthless person. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (d) + (f) + (e) + (c) + (b) + (g) + (a) + (h) Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
